name: Strančice (Czechia)
description: Divided into six rectangles in two rows, green, white and yellow above and yellow, green and white below, the yellow forming a central cross-shaped area with the white and green corners.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 9 April 2002 (decision No. 104) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.

features.role: chequy of green, white and yellow
